 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 28 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Rest, recoup and remember that you are the one who can influence your emotions and moods. Yes, the full moon energies may get to you, but Cancer , instead of looking at all that spilled milk, choose what you wish to savour and salvage. Then move forwards with that in your field of focus and vision. You are capable of creating your life with ease and grace, and there is no need to try powering through things in ways that come naturally to others but not to you.
 Cosmic tip: Use the power of your intention and willpower to create the magic you wish to see.
